title: Driver Strikes 4 People Outside a Mall in British Columbia, Killing 2, Police Say
summary_full: The accident occurred as hundreds of people were gathering nearby for a National Day of Truth and Reconciliation march near Delta, a city south of Vancouver, the authorities said.
